caveats: Official Hoga Kusten and Naturkartan access notes say this section has no bus connection.
This is the closest practical public-transport fallback found for Gavik, not a direct trailhead stop.
Route 218 timetable found for 2025-12-14 to 2026-06-14; recheck DinTur for travel dates and summer 2026 service.

caveats: Not directly at Lappudden, but official section-4 access notes name Nordingra Vallen as the access stop for Lappudden-Ullanger.
Use as the safer official/practical access recommendation; keep Jaresta as closer fallback only.

commuteAccess.officialAccessNote: Do not mark Gavik or Lappudden as directly transit-served. Current Hoga Kusten and Naturkartan text says no bus connection for this section.

facilities.name: GaviksTorpets Bed & Breakfast
facilities.description: Start-area lodging and service cluster at Gavik. Sources support lodging, guest service, drinking water/service water, toilet/shower access, arranged food-shopping support, pickup/dropoff support and trail logistics.
caveats: Private/commercial service; verify current operating status and what is available to non-guests.
Model water, toilet, shower and transfer support as service-dependent amenities rather than public standalone facilities.

facilities.name: Parkering, Gavik
facilities.description: Small parking area at the end of the public road in Norr-Gavik. Naturkartan says there are no other facilities at this specific parking point.
caveats: Keep separate from GaviksTorpet service cluster.

facilities.name: Picnic table near Gavik start
facilities.description: OSM-only picnic/rest point near the GPX start.
caveats: No official source found; verify before importing as a user-facing facility.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Algaberget
facilities.description: Shelter with fireplace on the Algaberget side trail, close to a viewpoint. Field reports and official text treat Algaberget as one of the worthwhile short detours from the road/gravel-heavy main route.
caveats: Model fireplace as conditionally usable under current fire-ban rules.
No reliable water or waste facility was found at this shelter.

facilities.name: Utsiktsplats, Algaberget
facilities.description: Viewpoint on the Algaberget side trail, adjacent to the shelter/fireplace cluster.
caveats: May be better merged into the Algaberget shelter detail rather than imported as a separate icon.

facilities.name: Informal campsite below Algaberget
caveats: No official camping source found for this point.
Do not import as an endorsed campsite without field verification or an official source.

facilities.name: Ryd dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM dry-toilet marker near Ryd. Older/legacy Hoga Kusten material references a dry toilet at Ryd, but current official/Naturkartan section material did not clearly list it in the first pass.
caveats: Coordinate and current presence need verification before import.
Legacy official mention may be stale.

facilities.name: Fiske, Rydtjarnen
facilities.description: Fishing water near the route. Naturkartan/official notes indicate fishing requires a permit. This is not evidence of potable drinking water.
caveats: Import only if fishing/attraction POIs are supported.
Do not import as drinking water.

facilities.name: Utsiktsplats, Rodklitten
facilities.description: Viewpoint on the Rodklitten side trail. Official section text and field reports describe Rodklitten as a worthwhile but steeper side trip with views and hillfort context.
caveats: Do not let the steep side trip inflate the main section difficulty.
May be combined with the Rodklitten hillfort record.

facilities.name: Fornborg, Rodklitten
facilities.description: Hillfort/heritage site at Rodklitten with viewpoint and world-heritage visitor-place context.
caveats: Import if heritage/attraction taxonomy is supported; otherwise merge into Rodklitten viewpoint side-trip note.

facilities.name: Jarnsta Cafe
facilities.description: Cafe/food service near the final third of the section. Useful as a nearby service point if open.
caveats: Opening status and seasonal hours need verification before importing as reliable food.
Use exact business spelling/source once normalized.

facilities.name: Korningsgarden / Kiorningsgarden
facilities.description: Nearby lodging/food/service candidate east of Lappudden.
caveats: Verify current operation, exact name and services before import.
May be better treated as nearby service rather than on-route facility.

facilities.name: Lappuddens Friluftscenter
facilities.description: Endpoint outdoor center with lodging, paid camping/tent pitches, drinking water, toilets, showers, kitchen/service building, parking, food/kiosk/restaurant services, sauna, swimming, rentals and InfoPoint context depending on season and booking.
caveats: Private/commercial and seasonal service. Lappudden's 2026 page says main season 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-11 and autumn opening 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04, with Annexet year-round.
Model water, toilets, showers, food and campsite as service-dependent amenities.
Do not treat paid campsite/service building as unrestricted wild camping.

camping: No section-specific wild-camping prohibition was found. General Swedish allemansratt applies outside private/cultivated/sensitive areas.
Lappudden offers paid tent pitches/camping and service building access; model this as private/commercial camping, not unrestricted public camping.
The OSM-only campsite below Algaberget should remain pending or suppressed until verified.
shelters: Vindskydd, Algaberget is the only high-confidence shelter found for this section in the first pass.
fireplaces: Lappudden has guest camping/grill/service context, but use is tied to site rules and seasonal/private operation.
toilets: Ryd dry toilet is an OSM/legacy clue and needs verification before import.

dogs.summary: No section-specific dog rule found. General Swedish dog rules apply: extra control 1 March-20 August and leash/control around wildlife and grazing animals.

huntingForestry.summary: No section-specific hunting or forestry closure found. The route passes rural/forest/agricultural land where hunting and forestry may occur seasonally; obey signs and keep dogs close.

closuresReroutes.summary: No current temporary closure or reroute found for Gavik-Lappudden in official Hoga Kusten, Naturkartan, Lansstyrelsen/Kramfors pages or targeted searches in the section-3 first pass.

safetyNotes: Main route is officially easy and largely gravel road.
Rodklitten and Algaberget are side trips; Rodklitten has steeper rock/hillfort terrain and should be treated as a side-trip caution.
Rydtjarnen fishing requires a fishing permit.
Official sources say no bus connection; do not imply easy public-transit access at Gavik or Lappudden.

sourceContradictions.details: Current Hoga Kusten and Naturkartan visible title use Etapp 3 Gavik-Lappudden, while Naturkartan URL/GPX slug and multiple field reports use old Etapp 4 naming.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use current Etapp 3 identity and preserve old Etapp 4 as alias/stale-source caveat.

sourceContradictions.details: Current official pages list 9.4 km and the official GPX computes 9.349 km; legacy official PDF lists 11.5 km.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use 9.4 km/current GPX for current route. Treat 11.5 km as stale legacy distance.

sourceContradictions.details: The embedded GPX contains the current 273-point route segment ending at 62.932125,18.255243 plus a one-point extra segment at 62.933551,18.250996.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use only the first route segment; do not flatten the one-point segment into the route.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM relation 19096562 starts consistently at Gavik but ends about 217 m from the official GPX endpoint and does not stitch cleanly into OSM section 4.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Use OSM as QA only, not endpoint authority.

sourceContradictions.details: Official sources say no bus connection. DinTur stops exist within a few kilometers by road but not at the trailheads.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Do not mark trailheads as directly transit-served. Store Saltea, Nordingra Vallen and Jaresta as fallback/nearby access with caveats.

sourceContradictions.details: Naturkartan lists rich services at Lappudden; Lappudden's own 2026 site indicates seasonal operating windows for most services.
sourceContradictions.resolutionForImport: Import as service-dependent and seasonal/private, not always-available public infrastructure.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM and older material suggest a dry toilet at Ryd, while current official section/Naturkartan source set did not clearly confirm it.

researchIterations.summary: Overview pass established current 9-section trail structure, tested section 3 GPX availability, and identified current/legacy numbering risks.

agents.summary: Confirmed current identity, official stats, official descriptions, facilities, world-heritage context and legacy Etapp 4 / 11.5 km stale-source risks.
Validated Naturkartan GPX, Hoga Kusten embedded GPX segment structure, OSM relation 19096562 and endpoint continuity with adjacent sections.
Collected and coordinate-checked facility candidates at GaviksTorpet, Gavik parking, Algaberget, Ryd, Rydtjarnen, Rodklitten, Jarnsta, Korningsgarden and Lappudden.
Confirmed official no-bus note; selected Saltea as Gavik fallback, Nordingra Vallen as official/practical Lappudden access, and Jaresta as closer fallback with route-218 caveats.
Reviewed AllTrails, blogs, Utsidan, Hiking in Finland, We12Travel, Reddit, Wikiloc and Komoot for terrain, side trips, service caveats and current closure signals.
Checked protected-area/rule context, fire-ban status, camping, dogs, hunting/forestry, water reliability, closures/reroutes and safety risks.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: No extra agent batch needed before section handoff. Remaining issues are import-time or targeted verification items: no direct bus access, route-218 timetable currentness after 2026-06-14, Ryd dry toilet verification, informal Algaberget campsite suppression/verification, Lappudden seasonality, and OSM endpoint mismatch.

researchIterations.summary: Calculated approximate nearest straight-line distances from candidate facility coordinates to the official Naturkartan GPX points for route-proximity classification.

openQuestions: Keep Ryd dry toilet pending until local/official verification supports importing a separate toilet amenity.
Suppress or independently verify the OSM-only informal campsite below Algaberget; do not import as official camping from OSM alone.
Decide whether Algaberget and Rodklitten side-trip features should import as separate POIs or be merged into route-detail text.
Resolve exact naming/source for Jarnsta Cafe and Korningsgarden/Kiorningsgarden if they are imported as nearby services.
If commute data is later imported from GTFS, replace DinTur/Fskab research stop ids and coordinates with authoritative Trafiklab/ResRobot stop ids and coordinates.
